case.scientific_claim: Does substrate-associated HiSiaP intersite conformational change agree between DEER and smFRET across labeling pairs, and does changing the 175/228 fluorophore pair affect that agreement?

sources.construct_and_condition: HiSiaP labeled at 175_228;apo and1mM sialicacid holo source-labelled three repetitions percondition.
sources.sample_composition: AlexaFluor555/AlexaFluor647 double labels; site-specific calibration applicability UNKNOWN.
sources.native_observable: APBS photon counts AA DD DA AD and burst times; original source exports, no calculated efficiencies supplied to this probe.
sources.estimand: Conditional fluorescence efficiency and stoichiometry under declared correction; structural closure requires an appropriate probe bridge.
sources.spatial_support: Two labeling positions 175_228; not C-alpha geometry.
sources.unit_or_aggregation: Technical segments within three source-labelled repetitions;140 files over two pairs; counts not independent biological repeats.
